text:
sara-cs: Heads up — acme-app in prod is seeing 403s on batch embeddings calls but single-item embeddings succeed. They say the service key was created via our CLI last week. Logs:
sara-cs: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '{"input":["a","b"]}' -> 403 {\"error\":\"missing_scope: embeddings\"}

tom-cs: ugh. Do we have the key id? can you paste the token preview from the admin UI (no full token) or the key metadata? vendor said they used redwoodctl create-key --scopes "inference rerank embeddings"

siva-eng: quick thought: our CLI historically accepted comma-separated scopes. If they passed a space-delimited string in quotes some shells might pass it as a single arg — we then split on "," only and default to the first scope. That would explain why inference works but embeddings is missing.

sara-cs: key id is key_01Hxxxxx — admin UI shows scopes: ["inference"]

ron-eng: yep that matches. CLI bug: when scopes arg contains spaces and no commas we only store the raw string and then our provisoner tokenizes on comma. So scope list becomes one item 'inference rerank embeddings' which we validate against allowed scopes and only match prefix 'inference'. Fix is straightforward but need hotfix for provisioning path.

tom-cs: mitigation for customer: create a new key via Console (select checkboxes) or run: 

redwoodctl create-key --name "acme-batch-key" --scopes=inference,embeddings,rerank --tenant acme-app

siva-eng: agree. Also add server-side validation on create-key to reject space-separated lists and surface a clear error. I'll open a small PR.

elaine-cs: Customer impacted by batch jobs — they run nightly vector-upsert of ~200k docs. They want us to rotate with minimal downtime. Can we expedite a console key creation and offer a short runbook? I can create the key in admin and give them a non-rotating temp key while we patch.

ron-eng: we can create a scoped key and mark it non-rotating. I'll do it now and log the action.

deploy-bot: patch/redwoodctl-scope-parse scheduled for rollout to prod tomorrow 02:00 UTC (canary first).

sara-cs: Customer accepted temp key, batch jobs resumed. Filing follow-up to ensure we surface a better error message when provisioning fails. :thumbsup:

tom-cs: note for ops — search audit logs for redwoodctl create-key invocations last 7 days to find other affected tenants.

siva-eng: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/redwoodctl/pull/482 - adds parsing fallback and unit tests. Will add server-side validation in a follow-up.

elaine-cs: thanks all, closing loop with customer now. "
